rows.ts: Ku suka eka mirhi ya wena

rows.english: Sourced South African seasons, all regions together — your own trees may start or finish a month either side.
rows.zu: Izikhathi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezicashunwe emithonjeni, zonke izifunda ndawonye — izihlahla zakho zingaqala noma ziphele ngenyanga ngaphambili noma ngemuva.
rows.st: Dinako tsa Afrika Borwa tse tswang mehloding, dibaka tsohle di kopantswe — difate tsa hao di ka qala kapa tsa qeta kgwedi pele kapa morao.
rows.ts: Minkarhi ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi humaka eswihlobyeni, tindhawu hinkwato ti hlanganisiwile — mirhi ya wena yi nga sungula kumbe yi heta n’hweti ku nga si fika kumbe endzhaku ka nkarhi lowu.
rows.ve: Zwifhinga zwa Afrika Tshipembe zwi bvaho kha zwiko, madzingu oṱhe o ṱangana — miri yaṋu i nga thoma kana ya fhedza ṅwedzi phanḓa kana nga murahu.

rows.st: Ha ho mosebetsi o lokelang ho etswa jwale.
rows.ts: A ku na leswi faneleke ku endliwa sweswi.
rows.ve: A hu na zwine zwa tea u itwa zwino.

rows.english: Switch to a different design's production plan
rows.st: Fetohela polaneng ya tlhahiso ya moralo o mong
rows.ts: Cincela eka pulani ya vuhumelerisi ya dizayini yin’wana
rows.ve: Shandukelani kha pulane ya vhubveledzi ya muṅwe muolo

rows.english: Plants and housing from your map
rows.st: Dimela le matlo a diphoofolo tse tswang mmapeng wa hao
rows.ts: Swimila ni tindlu ta swifuwo leswi humaka eka mepe wa wena
rows.ve: Zwimela na nnḓu dza zwifuwo zwi bvaho kha mapa waṋu

rows.english: Check the beds and plots this plan is using — count, sizes and where they came from
rows.zu: Hlola imibhede namapuloti asetshenziswa yilolu hlelo — inani, ubukhulu nomthombo
rows.st: Hlahloba mealo le ditsha tse sebediswang ke polane ena — palo, boholo le moo di tswang teng
rows.ts: Kambela mibedo ni switandi leswi pulani leyi yi swi tirhisaka — nhlayo, vukulu ni laha swi humaka kona
rows.ve: Sedzani mibedu na zwitandana zwine pulane iyi ya shumisa — mbalo, vhuhulwane na hune zwa bva hone

rows.st: Polane ya tlhahiso e a kenngwa…
rows.ve: Pulane ya vhubveledzi i khou dzheniswa…

rows.english: No saved designs yet. Draw your beds in the Design Studio and this is where they will appear.
rows.zu: Azikho izakhiwo ezilondoloziwe okwamanje. Dweba imibhede yakho ku-Design Studio; izovela lapha.
rows.st: Ha ho meralo e bolokilweng. Taka mealo ya hao ho Design Studio, mme e tla hlaha mona.
rows.ts: A ku na tidizayini leti hlayisiweke. Dirowa mibedo ya wena eka Design Studio kutani yi ta humelela laha.
rows.ve: A hu athu u vha na miolo yo vhulungwaho. Olani mibedu yaṋu kha Design Studio nahone i ḓo vhonala fhano.

rows.english: saved designs. Each one is drawn as it sits on the ground.
rows.zu: imiklamo elondoloziwe. Ngayinye iboniswa njengoba injalo emhlabeni.
rows.st: meralo e bolokilweng. O mong le o mong o takilwe kamoo o leng kateng fatshe.
rows.ts: tidizayini leti hlayisiweke. Yin’wana ni yin’wana yi dirowiwe hi laha yi nga ha kona ehansi.
rows.ve: miolo yo vhulungwaho. Muṅwe na muṅwe wo oliwa nga hune wa vha ngaho fhasi.

rows.english: Or use the design already open on this device
rows.zu: Noma sebenzisa umklamo ovuliwe kule divayisi
rows.st: Kapa sebedisa moralo o seng o butswe sesebedisweng sena
rows.ts: Kumbe tirhisa dizayini leyi se yi pfulekeke eka xitirhisiwa lexi
rows.ve: Kana shumisani muolo wo no vuleaho kha tshishumiswa itshi

rows.english: Place real beds on the Planting step
rows.st: Beha mealo ya nnete mohatong wa Ho lema
rows.ts: Veka mibedo ya xiviri eka goza ra Ku byala
rows.ve: Vheani mibedu ya vhukuma kha ḽiga ḽa U ṱavha

rows.st: Hlahisa tlhahiso ya polane ka boiketsetso
rows.ve: Bveledzani themendelo ya pulane nga yoṱhe

rows.english: Undo the last change to this plan
rows.zu: Buyisela emuva ushintsho lokugcina kulolu hlelo
rows.st: Kgutlisa phetoho ya ho qetela polaneng ena
rows.ts: Tlherisela endzhaku ku cinca ko hetelela eka pulani leyi
rows.ve: Humisani tshanduko ya u fhedza kha pulane iyi

rows.english: Clear every planting from this plan
rows.st: Tlosa tsohle tse lenngweng polaneng ena
rows.ts: Susa ku byala hinkwako eka pulani leyi
rows.ve: Bvisani zwoṱhe zwo ṱavhiwaho kha pulane iyi

rows.st: Mealo e meng e abetswe habedi ka nako e le nngwe
rows.ts: Mibedo yin’wana yi averiwe kambirhi hi nkarhi wun’we
rows.ve: Miṅwe mibedu yo avhelwa kavhili nga tshifhinga tshithihi

rows.english: No plantings yet — tap + crop on a bed above.
rows.zu: Akukho okutshalwe okwamanje — cindezela + crop embhedeni ongenhla.
rows.st: Ha ho dijalo tse jetsweng — tlanya + crop moalong o ka hodimo.
rows.ts: A ku na leswi byariweke — khumba + crop eka mubedo lowu nga ehenhla.
rows.ve: A hu athu u ṱavhiwa — kwanyani + crop kha mubedu u re nṱha.
A hu athu u ṱavhiwa tshithu.

rows.ts: A ku na mibedo leyi dirowiweke
rows.ve: A hu athu u oliwa mibedu

rows.english: Place veg beds on the Planting step first — then come back here to plan what goes in them.
rows.zu: Qala ngokubeka imibhede yemifino esigabeni sokuTshala — bese ubuya lapha uzohlela okuzotshalwa kuyo.
rows.st: Qala ka ho beha mealo ya meroho mohatong wa Ho lema — ebe o kgutlela mona ho rera tse tla kena ho yona.
rows.ts: Rhanga hi ku veka mibedo ya matsavu eka goza ra Ku byala — kutani u vuya laha u kunguhata leswi nga ta nghena eka yona.
rows.ve: Thomani nga u vhea mibedu ya miroho kha ḽiga ḽa U ṱavha — ni kone u vhuya fhano u dzudzanya zwine zwa ḓo dzheniswa khayo.

rows.english: Crop chart months, scroll to match the planting calendar
rows.zu: Izinyanga zeshadi lezitshalo; skrola ukuze zihambisane nekhalenda lokutshala
rows.st: Dikgwedi tsa tjhate ya dijalo, tsamaisetsa ka thoko ho di bapisa le khalendara ya ho lema
rows.ts: Tin’hweti ta chati ya swibyariwa, fambisa hi tlhelo leswaku ti fambelana ni khalendara yo byala
rows.ve: Miṅwedzi ya tshati ya zwiliṅwa, sudzulusani nga thungo u i ṱanganya na khalenda ya u ṱavha

rows.st: Kenya e le se seng se le teng
rows.ts: Engetela tani hi lexi se xi nga kona
Vuhundzuluxeri bya swilawuri byo ka byi nga si kamberiwa
rows.ve: Ṱhalutshedzelo dza ndangulo dzi sa athu u khwaṱhisedzwa

rows.english: These control translations have not been reviewed by a fluent speaker. Some screen text still uses English.
rows.zu: Lokhu kuhumusha kwezinkinobho akukakabuyekezwa umuntu olukhuluma kahle ulimi. Omunye umbhalo wesikrini usasebenzisa isiNgisi.
rows.st: Diphetolelo tsena tsa ditaolo ha di eso hlahlojwe ke motho ya buang puo hantle. Mongolo o mong wa skrine o ntse o le ka Senyesemane.
rows.ts: Vuhundzuluxeri bya swilawuri leswi a byi si kamberiwa hi munhu loyi a tivaka ririmi kahle. Matsalwa man’wana ya xikirini ma ha tirhisa Xinghezi.
rows.ve: Ṱhalutshedzelo idzi dza ndangulo a dzi athu u sedzwa nga muthu a ambaho luambo nga nḓila yavhuḓi. Miṅwe miṅwalo ya tshikirini i kha ḓi shumisa Luisimane.

rows.st: Ha ho dijalo tse tsamaellanang le “{search}”.
rows.ts: A ku na swibyariwa leswi fambelanaka na “{search}”.
rows.ve: A hu na zwiliṅwa zwi tshimbilelanaho na “{search}”.

rows.english: Started as a seedling, then transplanted
rows.zu: Kuqale kuyisithombo, kwase kutshalwa endaweni entsha
rows.st: Se qadile e le sethopo, sa nto fallisetswa sebakeng se seng
rows.ts: Xi sungule tani hi ximilana lexitsongo, kutani xi rhurhiseriwa endhawini yin’wana
rows.ve: Tsho thoma tshi tshimilana tshiṱuku, tsha kona u pfuluselwa kha huṅwe fhethu

rows.st: Se jetswe ka kotloloho ka peo
rows.ts: Xi byariwe hi mbewu hi ku kongoma
rows.ve: Tsho zwalwa nga mbeu nga ho livhaho

rows.english: Twelve dots = Jan to Dec. Green marks the months you can sow that crop in this site's rainfall pattern.
rows.zu: Amachashazi ayishumi nambili = Januwari kuya kuDisemba. Okuluhlaza kukhombisa izinyanga ongahlwanyela ngazo leso silimo ngokuhamba kwemvula kwalesi siza.
rows.st: Matheba a leshome le metso e mmedi = Pherekgong ho isa Tshitwe. Botala bo tshwaya dikgwedi tseo o ka jalang sejalo seo ho tsona ho latela mokgwa wa dipula sebakeng sena.
rows.ts: Mathonsi ya khumembirhi = Sunguti ku ya N'wendzamhala. Rihlaza ri fungha tin’hweti leti u nga byalaka xibyariwa xexo ha tona hi ku ya hi fambelo ra mpfula ra ndhawu leyi.
rows.ve: Zwithoma zwa fumimbili = Phando u swika Nyendavhusiku. Mudala u sumbedza miṅwedzi ine na nga zwala tshiliṅwa tshenetsho khayo u ya nga maitele a mvula a fhethu afha.

rows.zu: Sidinga indawo enkulu — sidinga umbhede waso
rows.st: Se hloka sebaka se seholo — se batla moalo wa sona
rows.ts: Xi lava ndhawu leyikulu — xi lava mubedo wa xona
rows.ve: Tshi ṱoḓa tshikhala tshihulwane — tshi ṱoḓa mubedu watsho

rows.english: Nothing is scheduled for picking in the beds, and nothing with a sourced shelf life is still in store.
rows.zu: Akukho okuhlelelwe ukukhiwa emibhedeni, futhi akukho okunobude besikhathi sokugcina obusekelwe emthonjeni okusagciniwe.
rows.st: Ha ho letho le reretsweng ho kgwa meallong, mme ha ho letho le nang le nako ya ho bolokwa e tswang mohloding le ntseng le bolokilwe.
rows.ts: A ku na lexi kunguhatiweke ku khiwa emibedweni, naswona a ku na lexi nga ni nkarhi wo hlayisiwa lowu humaka eka xihlovo lexi ha riki evuhlayiselweni.
rows.ve: A hu na zwo dzudzanywaho u kaṋiwa mibeduni, nahone a hu na zwi re na tshifhinga tsha u vhulunga tshi bvaho kha tshiko zwine zwa kha ḓi vha vhuvhulungeloni.

rows.st: Ho tswa difateng tsa hao (dikgwedi tsa lehae tsa ho kga)
rows.ts: Ku suka eka mirhi ya wena (tin’hweti ta laha kaya to kha)
rows.ve: U bva kha miri yaṋu (miṅwedzi ya henefho ya u kaṋa)

rows.st: Ho tswa diphoofolong tsa hao (dikgwedi tsa lehae tsa tlhahiso)
rows.ts: Ku suka eka swifuwo swa wena (tin’hweti ta laha kaya ta vuhumelerisi)
rows.ve: U bva kha zwifuwo zwaṋu (miṅwedzi ya henefho ya vhubveledzi)

reviewJournal.reason: Reuse the established canonical row; do not create a second translation for the same authored source. Original contextual Zulu call arguments still win in the UI helper.

Older generated-wording guard was scoped to prior producer edits and correctly failed on newly authorized control presentation. Added exact helper/import/notice restoration before its original whole-page assertion; retained independent producer-wiring difference and all original comparisons. New whole-page mutation negative check still rejects unrelated changes.
Synthetic fixture initially used the wrong plot-field name; corrected setup to the real PlanBed kind:plot schema and existing400m² test plot. No assertion removed.
Actual SeedBadge renderer required its Sprout binding and recursive renderer return type; fixed isolated test scope. No application bug was inferred.
The first raw-HTML close-label assertion rejected correctly escaped Xitsonga apostrophe. Compare rendered attribute text and retain a wrong-month negative with the visibleDecemberheading intact.

Recovery source copies under output were accidentally included by TypeScript. Renamed9backup source files to.ts.txt/.tsx.txt and verified every original recovery hash; no application source, tests or tsconfig changed to suppress diagnostics.

taskPresentation.grouping: Original groupTasksByAction and English shared-detail comparison remain unchanged; localize only the displayed task label/count/how-to, using original task identity and source-detail match.
taskPresentation.sharedText: Shared-task URL is tested with mocked window.open only; never send real tasks or open WhatsApp in verification. Existing English default stays exact. Native title, task clauses, picking and month labels use their canonical authorities.
taskPresentation.dynamic: The2original dynamic source sentences are now full templates, interpolating raw search values once and using canonical short month labels. Zulu month labels now native intentionally.49literal oldEnglish/Zu arguments stay exact.
taskPresentation.notice: Replaced the obsolete Zulu assertion that all tasks remain English with the same honest four-language unreviewed-controls note; original notice retained in sourceChanges.replacedNotice.
taskPresentation.remaining: Other crop text, metadata, accepted notes, animal/recording/picker/detail flows and whole application remain unfinished.
taskPresentation.counterWrap: Actual360px Ve panel had one31.5px counter versus15.75px peers. Native-only nowrap/flexShrink0 keeps number+noun together; all current native counters measured15.75px. Realbefore fails peer-height rule. English styles remain exact.

pickerListPresentation: Native source-bound sowing-dot explanation and seed/space accessible titles; crop names, verified-timing filter, month identities, favourites and state callbacks remain unchanged. Selected-crop detail form remains unfinished. Month-detail visible and accessible headings share canonical short month identity.
monthStaticPresentation: Five whole original labels/empty-state clauses translated; empty beds and sourced shelf-life storage remain distinct. Tree/animal source reference bodies and storage instructions still require remaining locale wiring. No pantry record, month selection, source number or model changed.
